title: Substance of Light, a UV Skin Care Brand, Wins the First Sephora Prize for Emerging European Brands
summary: “I think newcomers need help in understanding how to scale properly, and at the right pace, and we want to support them,” said Catherine Spindler, Sephora Europe and Middle East president, of the retailer's new prize for emerging European beauty brands.
author: Samantha Conti

title: Teen Beauty Spend Is Up, as Is Rhode’s Stock, Piper Sandler Survey Shows
summary: The brand — led by Hailey Bieber and backed by E.l.f. Beauty — entered Piper Sandler’s annual Teen Survey for the first time this year, as skin care and cosmetics spend rose 5 percent.
